MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 32GB microSD card with an adapter fits my repeated memory-card purchases and gives me flexibility with my card reader and compatible devices.",
    "The HD streaming stick adds a useful playback option alongside my TV and recently purchased DVD player."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Photography accessories do not mean I need a home-monitoring camera, and practical device purchases do not imply an interest in voice control.",
    "Battery backup and a tablet keyboard solve needs I have not shown, while a larger tablet overlaps with what my Fire 7 already does.",
    "The 4K stick's extra features offer little benefit for my listed 720p TV. I would choose one suitable HD stick rather than multiple streaming devices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire 7 purchase seems to have been treated as broad interest in Amazon devices, although each device serves a different purpose.",
    "Shared words such as camera and power seem to carry too much weight: a security camera differs from photography equipment, and a UPS differs from a power strip."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, adapters, and a card reader show that storage format and compatibility matter to me.",
    "What I already own matters: an accessory or an added capability can be useful without making a replacement device necessary.",
    "Related products can be alternatives rather than things I need together; I prefer the flexible 32GB microSD option over the 16GB SD card on this page."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my storage and playback interests but stretched those interests into devices that do not serve a current need."
}
